independent_reviewer_counterclaim: The strongest objection is that a session which first reported a retired determination as standing, and recommended a retrieval the owner had already ruled closed, should not be trusted to have chosen the nine terms either: at least two of them are named differently from the phrases the held codes use (turning circle where the ADA text says turning space; headroom clearance where sources say vertical clearance), two terms' definitions stated a direction (turning circle: 'Minimum space'; operating force: 'Maximum force'; repaired by the second migration after the code review), and no source has been read against any of the nine.
